about: The shortlist for the one sound on the big moment (THE_BAR ruling 11, "Only the big moment"; scripts/velib/sfx.py).
A row is a candidate, never an approval: config/sfx-approved.json holds only what Krish approved by ear, in his words.
provider_id comes from Epidemic Sound's search. file (a path under MINDMAKE_MUSIC_ROOT) and sha256 are filled only after Krish says yes to downloading it; his plan covers sound effects (29 Oct 2026).
gain_db is the level the sound is auditioned at, relative to full scale; ve sfx audition measures each hit against his voice.
